rule.name: LegacyCalendarApi
rule.message: Calendar.getInstance() and new GregorianCalendar() without a time zone, and new SimpleDateFormat(...) without setTimeZone, read the default time zone and are not thread-safe. Use java.time with an explicit zone: Instant, or ZonedDateTime.now(clock), and a DateTimeFormatter with withZone(zone).

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getInstance'][*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Calendar']]] [not(ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')])] | //ConstructorCall[ClassType[@SimpleName = 'GregorianCalendar']] [not(ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')])] | //ConstructorCall[ClassType[@SimpleName = 'SimpleDateFormat']] [let $scope := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::ClassBody][1], $format := parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return empty($format) or not($scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'setTimeZone']/*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $format]])] )
